splice_insert_with_pts_adjustment.note: Same as splice_insert_basic but pts_adjustment set to 900000 ticks (10.000s) — regression test for the pts_adjustment-never-applied bug. pts_time_s must be exactly 10.000s greater than splice_insert_basic's; break_duration_s must be unchanged (it's a relative span, not an absolute time, so pts_adjustment does not apply to it).

time_signal_provider_ad_start.note: Hand-built time_signal + one segmentation_descriptor (Provider Advertisement Start, Ad-ID upid) — exercises the descriptor loop and glossary-linked segmentation type name, not covered by the splice_insert samples.

too_short.note: Fewer than 14 bytes — must hit the length guard, not throw.

bad_table_id.note: First byte isn't 0xFC — must hit the table_id guard, not throw or misparse.
